name: Chop Point
description_short: Overnight camp for teenagers ages 12 to 18 in Woolwich, Maine, run by a Christian nonprofit since 1967. Campers set their own daily schedule from sports, sailing, windsurfing, kayaking, art and music, choose one to five day trips each session, and leave devices at home.
refund_policy_summary: A $500 deposit is required and is not refundable; the balance is due two weeks before arrival. No refund for early withdrawal, cancellation or dismissal.
notes: Three week sessions at $2,800, or the full six weeks for $5,000. Staff transport campers to and from the Portland Jetport on opening and closing days at no charge. Rough dry laundry included. Partial scholarships up to $500 per session.
